name: vibe-kit
description: Install and maintain a repository-pinned Vibe Kit workflow from a bundled offline payload.

interface.shortDescription: Let Codex adopt the Vibe Kit operating protocol.
interface.longDescription: Agent-first bootstrap and maintenance from a version-matched offline payload. Upgrades use content-bound receipts and truthfully stop at the manual new-task activation fallback unless the host supplies live conformance evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Adopt or maintain Vibe Kit for this repository, then let me continue in ordinary development language.
